objective: A complete architectural migration playbook for transforming legacy SaaS chatbots into AI-native Generative UI applications, with OpenTelemetry telemetry, SLAs, and rollout strategies.

key_findings: A 4-phase strangler-fig migration pattern enables incremental rollout of generative UI widgets without disrupting existing chatbot users.
Standardizing OpenTelemetry semantic conventions (`genui.stream.ttft`, `genui.render.duration`, `genui.tool.call`) enables end-to-end observability.
Canary deployments with feature flags (LaunchDarkly) allow progressive migration of high-value tools (dashboards, forms) first.
Establishing strict SLOs (P99 render time < 50ms, client crash rate < 0.01%) ensures enterprise SLA compliance during cutover.
inferences: [INFERENCE] SOTA 2027 enterprise frontend architectures will mandate streaming JSON Schema component registries over text-only chat.
[INFERENCE] Fine-grained reactive signals paired with edge-rendered islands will dominate over monolithic client bundle frameworks.
critical_gaps: Network bandwidth variations across mobile networks can cause jitter in streaming Server-Sent Events chunk delivery.
Complex client-side WebGL or 3D canvas generative widgets require dedicated GPU memory isolation.
